cd /app/polyglot
# For each candidate opener line, check: (a) Python treats rest as string, (b) C accepts the line at file scope
test_line() {
  local line="$1"
  # Python: does this line open a triple string (i.e., 'int main' after it is hidden)?
  local pyres
  pyres=$(printf '%s\nint main(){pass}\n' "$line" | python3 -c 'import sys; src=sys.stdin.read()
try:
    compile(src,"<t>","exec"); print("PY-OK")
except SyntaxError as e: print("PY-ERR",e.msg)')
  # C: is this line valid at file scope (followed by a valid main)?
  local cres
  cres=$(printf '%s\nint main(){return 0;}\n' "$line" | gcc -x c - -o /dev/null 2>&1 | head -1)
  if [ -z "$cres" ]; then cres="C-OK"; fi
  printf 'LINE=[%s]  %s | %s\n' "$line" "$pyres" "$cres"
}
test_line '""""'
test_line '""""; '
test_line '""""""'
test_line 'x = """"'
test_line 'int x = """";'
test_line 'const char* x = """";'
test_line 'char x[] = """";'
test_line '#include <stdio.h>'
test_line '"""" #x'
